summary: Executed both backend and frontend regression for post-deploy auth behavior on preview. Password-first login with stale trusted_device passed in UI; admin login and representative read-only endpoints passed without 500. One auth regression remains: preview response headers expose wildcard CORS without Access-Control-Allow-Credentials for cross-origin login-origin probe.

critical.issue: CORS credential contract failed on preview edge for cross-origin probe: response returned Access-Control-Allow-Origin='*' and omitted Access-Control-Allow-Credentials, causing existing regression test test_login_cors_headers_for_preview_origin to fail.

action_items: Fix preview/edge CORS behavior for /api/auth/login so credentialed cross-origin requests return explicit Access-Control-Allow-Origin and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials=true (no wildcard with cookies).
Re-run test_iter345_preview_auth_login_flow.py after CORS fix to restore full auth regression pass status.

Optional playbook closure: add/restore an explicit seed_admin password-update contract test if this behavior is still required in current architecture (no seed_admin implementation found in backend runtime code).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is 3367 lines (>700 guideline) and should be split into focused modules to reduce auth/cors regression risk.
Auth API runtime is healthy for password flow (login, me, lockout, endpoint reads), but edge/header layer currently violates credentialed CORS contract under tested cross-origin condition.
No MONGODB _id serialization issue observed in tested responses.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use preview URL from frontend/.env. Verified UI behavior: stale trusted_device keeps password field visible by default, PIN field hidden until explicit toggle; admin login with مدير/010101 redirects to '/'. Representative reads passed: /api/users, /api/vehicles, /api/customers, /api/accounts, /api/finance/journal-entries?workshop_id=finmodule-sync, /api/finance/reports/income-statement?workshop_id=finmodule-sync. Persistent failing check is CORS credentials header contract in test_iter345_preview_auth_login_flow.py::test_login_cors_headers_for_preview_origin.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: call POST /api/auth/login on preview with Origin header (https://financial-ssot.preview.emergentagent.com) and valid credentials. Actual response includes Access-Control-Allow-Origin='*' and no Access-Control-Allow-Credentials despite backend middleware intending explicit credentialed origin. Likely root cause is preview edge/proxy CORS rewriting/normalization overriding backend headers, not core credential validation logic (login itself returns 200 and sets httpOnly cookies). Mitigation: enforce CORS at edge to mirror backend credentialed policy (explicit origin echo + allow-credentials=true), and avoid wildcard on auth routes.
